input_policy: RGB uint8 -> aspect-preserving letterbox with 114 padding -> FP32 /255; transform intrinsics with the exact resize/pad affine
pretrained_class_head: COCO-80 retained internally; export person/car/bus/truck scores for two product classes
candidate_layout: B x 32 x anchors; xyxy[4], COCO 0/2/5/7 sigmoid scores[4], eight (x,y,confidence) corners[24]; coordinates in model input pixels
candidate_selection: outside graph; highest of four class scores per anchor, score>0.25, descending stable order, at most100, no additional NMS; new prototype policy, not an accuracy-equivalent claim to Urban COCO-80 TopK
